description:
User approved the fz-9x7.37 page in Binary Handling's session ("fz-9x7.37 approved"; "proceed"). Settled: one site table per program (processes must be cheap); counters run in production (a compiler option to omit them is a possible later step); fixtures are re-expressed by intent, never re-blessed. Agreed with GC: .37 lands in full before the fz-9x7.11 collector steps. Builder: Binary Handling.

Step 3 of 4. Deleted: the five inline counters, the per-kind stored fields and alloc_count. Today the inline counters cost 15 instructions per allocation (Bugs and Cleanup's sum listing; Binary Handling's <<byte>> 78 vs 63).

comments.text:
Found by Binary Handling while building fz-9x7.37.1 (#776); added to this step's deletion and review list:
1. Heap::record_external_alloc (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs) has no caller; delete it here.
2. The site counts include the two entry closures the scheduler builds before a process resets its own stats. So 'heap_alloc_stats is a sum over sites' shifts the closure figures by that scaffolding. This moves pins: it goes on the per-fixture list for the user before fz-9x7.37.4.
From GC (#787): the five old counters now live in one helper, count_statistics, in src/compiler2/native_codegen/place.rs; .37.3 deletes them there.

Coverage check and measurement (Make Distiller Fast, 2026-11-24, develop de4ef6a3b, bench, 3 alternated rounds, outputs identical). Deleting the one count_statistics(body, kind, size) call at src/compiler2/native_codegen/place.rs:64: parse-only JSON decode 40.47G -> 39.20G instructions (-3.15%), whole distiller 54.18G -> 52.63G (-2.87%); cycles within noise. Prediction to judge against: about -3% distiller instructions, no cycle change. Patch: Make Distiller Fast's scratchpad ctr/ctr.patch; results ~/Workspace/fz/distill-hunt/gap/ctr.r/.
Sites the builder must also cover (not named above):
1. The alloc_count decrement emitted each time a continuation frame is given back (src/compiler2/native_codegen/closure.rs:324).
2. The runtime path: Heap::alloc_at (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs:220) updates alloc_stats.record and alloc_count in bump.
3. alloc_count's readers need a new source: Heap::live_count (runtime/src/heap/imp.rs:1541), used by the process telemetry line (runtime/src/telemetry.rs:340), src/exec/runtime.rs:429, tests, and gift accounting (runtime/src/heap/gift.rs:195). State what live_count becomes.
4. Site tables are per program while Process.heap_alloc_stats() is per process today; the settled design is one table per program. State what a process sees when a program runs several processes before building.
74 fixture files mention these stats; their list goes to the user under .37.4.

Builder: GC (assigned 2026-11-24; replaces Binary Handling). Order: straight after fz-9x7.47 is pushed (both rewrite heap/imp.rs bump/alloc). Page first, answering the four points above; the user approves before building. Prediction: distiller about -2.87% instructions, parse-only decode -3.15%, cycles flat.
Evidence moved somewhere lasting: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-distill-hunt/ctr/ (README.md with the annotated allocation sequence and the six-counter emit/read table, ctr.patch, ctr.sh).

Approved by the user 2026-11-24 ("proceed" on GC's page https://claude.ai/artifact/XoD6WX6HBf8kFV9nnfCJ9t, relayed by GC), with its three recommended decisions: (1) live_count is deleted; the exit line keeps bytes_used and GcStats keeps the kept-object count. (2) The figure is per program and renamed: Process.heap_alloc_stats() becomes System.alloc_stats(); reset_alloc_stats and its six calls go. (3) Off-heap buffers become RuntimeAllocSite::SharedBin, outside total. Building in ../fz-9x7-37-3 off develop 6ef88d2bd, in parallel with fz-9x7.47's re-bench; whichever lands second rebases. No fixture is re-blessed here; any fixture whose figure moves is listed for the user under .37.4.
